input.description: the size of :attr:`input` will determine size of the output tensor.

layout.description: the desired layout of returned tensor. Default: if ``None``, defaults to the layout of :attr:`input`.

device.description: the desired device of returned tensor. Default: if ``None``, defaults to the device of :attr:`input`.

requires_grad.description: If autograd should record operations on the returned tensor. Default: ``False``.

memory_format.description: the desired memory format of returned Tensor. Default: ``torch.preserve_format``.

fill_value.description: the number to fill the output tensor with.
